findings.title: A whole-row reason is masked on a row with no distance when the row's own reports state a distance-only reason
findings.cause: reportsReading returns one word by precedence (own reasons first); distanceFacts keeps only WHOLE_ROW_WITHHELD on a row with no distance, so SEVERAL_RECORDINGS or CORRECTED_MEASUREMENT hides REPORT_NOT_CARRIED
findings.output: unit: plain correction REPORT_NOT_CARRIED handed POOR; correction listing a recording or declaring a failure: withheld [], handed without POOR, work pace 270. Entry point, quality sessions weeks 3-6 at 255 s/km, watch POOR, athlete corrects: THRESHOLD_CONTROLLED [300,335] (plain correction, withheld x4) vs [290,325] (correction lists a recording, nothing withheld). a4a434f gives [290,325] for both.
findings.whyNotBlocking: the authorized rule (contract 3.3 rule 2, V4, table 3.5) is written for a row's distance, which is closed; this is the work pace of a row with no distance, covered only by the author's reading 1; pre-existing and reduced by the candidate
findings.closes: before integration or a real athlete: a whole-row reason withholds a row with no distance even when the row has its own distance reason, with a test of the quality-session case; or SSCTR and Founder state that the work pace of a row with no distance is outside the rule
